pnpm.//: pnpm 10 refuses to run a dependency's install script unless it is approved here, and on EAS that refusal is a hard error (ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS) — it failed the Android build with no obvious cause. sharp arrived transitively with Next.js when apps/dashboard was added, so the mobile build broke without mobile changing at all.
